fragment.choose:
<when condition="@((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerCodingMode", "detect") != "enforce"
                       || context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerCodingSkip", true))">
        
      
      
        <set-variable name="straikerRespRaw" value="@{
            try { return context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true) ?? ""; } catch { return ""; }
        }" />
        

        
        
        
        

        
          
            
            
              
                
                  @((string)context.Variables["straikerDetectUrl"])
                  POST
                  
                    @("Bearer " + (string)context.Variables["straikerCodingKey"])
                  
                  
                    application/json
                  
                  
                    @((string)context.Variables["straikerXTool"])
                  
                  
                    TRUE
                  
                  
                    @((string)context.Variables["straikerSessionId"])
                  
                  
                    response
                  
                  @{
                      var ev = new JObject {
                          ["hook_event_name"] = "Stop",
                          ["session_id"] = (string)context.Variables["straikerSessionId"],
                          ["user_name"] = (string)context.Variables["straikerUserName"],
                          ["app_response"] = (string)context.Variables["straikerAssistantText"],
                          ["stop_reason"] = "end_turn",
                          ["model"] = (string)context.Variables["straikerModel"]
                      };
                      return ev.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
                  }
                
              
            
          

          
            
            <send-request mode="new" response-variable-name="straikerPreToolResp"
                          timeout="@((int)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerTimeoutSec", 5))"
                          ignore-error="true">
              @((string)context.Variables["straikerDetectUrl"])
              POST
              
                @("Bearer " + (string)context.Variables["straikerCodingKey"])
              
              
                application/json
              
              
                @((string)context.Variables["straikerXTool"])
              
              
                TRUE
              
              
                @((string)context.Variables["straikerSessionId"])
              
              
              
                response-sync
              
              
                @((string)context.Variables["straikerModel"])
              
              @{
                  var tu = (JObject)context.Variables["straikerToolUse"];
                  var name = (string)(tu["name"] ?? "");
                  var ev = new JObject {
                      ["hook_event_name"] = "PreToolUse",
                      ["session_id"] = (string)context.Variables["straikerSessionId"],
                      ["user_name"] = (string)context.Variables["straikerUserName"],
                      ["tool_name"] = name,
                      ["tool_input"] = tu["input"] ?? new JObject(),
                      ["tool_use_id"] = tu["id"],
                      ["model"] = (string)context.Variables["straikerModel"]
                  };
                  // Surface MCP tools the way the native hooks do: mcp__server__tool
                  if (name.StartsWith("mcp__")) {
                      var bits = name.Split(new string[] { "__" }, StringSplitOptions.None);
                      if (bits.Length >= 3) {
                          ev["mcp_server_name"] = bits[1];
                          ev["mcp_tool_name"] = bits[2];
                      }
                  }
                  return ev.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
              }
            

            <set-variable name="straikerToolBlocked" value="@{
                var r = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerPreToolResp", null);
                if (r == null || r.StatusCode != 200) { return false; }
                try {
                    var body = r.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
                    var decision = (string)(body["hookSpecificOutput"]?["permissionDecision"] ?? "");
                    if (string.Equals(decision, "deny", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { return true; }
                    var action = (string)(body["action"] ?? "");
                    return string.Equals(action, "block", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                } catch { return false; }
            }" />
            <set-variable name="straikerToolReason" value="@{
                var r = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerPreToolResp", null);
                if (r == null || r.StatusCode != 200) { return "Tool call blocked by Straiker guardrails."; }
                try {
                    var body = r.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
                    var reason = (string)(body["hookSpecificOutput"]?["permissionDecisionReason"]
                                          ?? body["stopReason"] ?? body["reason"] ?? "");
                    return string.IsNullOrEmpty(reason) ? "Tool call blocked by Straiker guardrails." : reason;
                } catch { return "Tool call blocked by Straiker guardrails."; }
            }" />

            
              
                
                
                  
                  
                    application/json
                  
                  
                    block
                  
                  @{
                      var stub = new JObject {
                          ["id"] = "msg_straiker_blocked",
                          ["type"] = "message",
                          ["role"] = "assistant",
                          ["model"] = (string)context.Variables["straikerModel"],
                          ["content"] = new JArray { new JObject {
                              ["type"] = "text",
                              ["text"] = "⛔ Blocked by Straiker policy: " + (string)context.Variables["straikerToolReason"] } },
                          ["stop_reason"] = "end_turn",
                          ["stop_sequence"] = null,
                          ["usage"] = new JObject { ["input_tokens"] = 0, ["output_tokens"] = 0 }
                      };
                      return stub.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
                  }
